upstream_js:
'.sr-only': {
        position: 'absolute',
        width: '1px',
        height: '1px',
        padding: '0',
        margin: '-1px',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        clip: 'rect(0, 0, 0, 0)',
        whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
        borderWidth: '0',
      }

'.not-sr-only': {
        position: 'static',
        width: 'auto',
        height: 'auto',
        padding: '0',
        margin: '0',
        overflow: 'visible',
        clip: 'auto',
        whiteSpace: 'normal',
      }
